desc: Prove that \(k\) feasible pairs can be represented by pairing the first \(k\) mochi with the last \(k\) mochi in sorted order.
Compute each threshold index \(p_i\) using `bisect_left`, including the sentinel \(N\).
Build and query a sparse table for range maxima of \(D_i=p_i-i\).
Implement per-query binary search for the maximum feasible \(k\), with correct zero-based endpoint conversions.
Verify complexity, boundary cases, duplicate sizes, impossible pairs, and both public samples.
